title: Brunch Theme Contract
description: Shared contract for a single brunch theme. Consumed by brunch-content-data, brunch-frontend, brunch-tests, and brunch-docs.

id.description: Stable kebab-case identifier used as the cross-repo key.

accent.description: Name of an Open Color token (external, read-only), e.g. --oc-pink-2. The frontend applies it as the card accent; brunch-tests checks it exists in open-color/open-color.css.
